long_biography.plain_text:
MSC began as one cargo ship and became Gianluigi Aponte's defining business. He had trained at the Italian Maritime Academy, captained passenger ferries for his family's business and spent several years in banking before starting the carrier in 1970. From that small base, he developed it into one of the world's leading container lines.

Aponte's influence also extends through the MSC Foundation, which he chairs. Established by the family, the foundation concentrates the group's conservation, humanitarian and sustainable-development commitments. Through partnerships, it provides free transport and container space for humanitarian cargo and supports programmes in marine conservation and sustainable development.
